stable.title: DroidDeck 0.7.1
stable.summary: DroidDeck is 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld.

preview.title: fix(agent): start sessions from their own task so repeat starts aren't swallowed
preview.summary: After the first agent start following an install, droiddeckctl start stopped working: the app stayed on the launcher and droiddeckctl reported ACTIVITYSTARTFAILED ("no new session appeared") or hung.

recentPreviews.title: fix(agent): start sessions from their own task so repeat starts aren't swallowed
recentPreviews.summary: After the first agent start following an install, droiddeckctl start stopped working: the app stayed on the launcher and droiddeckctl reported ACTIVITYSTARTFAILED ("no new session appeared") or hung.

recentPreviews.title: fix(ubisoft): answer Orbit, login and process-only check-ins
recentPreviews.summary:
Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon (Ubisoft 205) never gets past a black screen. On a RedMagic with release 0.7.1:
• droiddeck-upc grants the start.
• The game opens orbitipcpipe, sends one request and waits there forever.

recentPreviews.title: fix(game-env): keep the x64 Visual C++ runtime in ARM64 prefixes
recentPreviews.summary: Since 0.7.1, Unreal Engine games such as Final Fantasy Resonance stop at "The following component(s) are required to run this program: Microsoft Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable (arm64)". The same games launched on 0.7.0.

recentPreviews.title: chore(ci): trust contributor for test builds
recentPreviews.summary: KeegantheVeganat0r is missing from the trusted test-build list, so their pull requests are not eligible for automatic signing through that list.

recentPreviews.title: fix: ship the Ubisoft launcher service as an add-on pack, scan only the standard APK on main
recentPreviews.summary: droiddeck-upc.exe (new in #2322) is the only new PE in the main APK and the likely source of the new Bkav and Elastic ML flags on main. It now ships as the ubisoft add-on pack: built by tools/packs/build.sh, published by publish-packs, fetched when a Ubisoft account is signed in, and staged into the guest rootfs by SessionFiles from the installed pack. The APK no longer contains it.

recentPreviews.title: Fix Electron Node mode sandbox injection
recentPreviews.summary: Fixes #2417 by skipping Chromium flag injection when the child environment enables Electron Node mode and carrying the child environment through exec and spawn wrappers.

recentPreviews.title: feat(ubisoft): Ubisoft Connect store with native sign-in, library, downloads and launch
recentPreviews.summary: Adds Ubisoft Connect as a store. Sign-in, the owned library, downloads and launching all run inside DroidDeck, with no Ubisoft Connect client. Ubisoft's own DRM DLLs are used unmodified, and the launch session carries a real ticket from Ubisoft's ownership service.

recentPreviews.title: feat: EA store with sign-in, library, native downloads, updates and launch without the EA app
recentPreviews.summary: Adds EA as a store. Games sign in, sync, download, update and launch without the EA app in the prefix.

recentPreviews.title: fix(input): system Back only turns into a right-click with an external mouse
recentPreviews.summary: On some handhelds the system Back button opens the guest's right-click menu instead of the side menu. Android injects Back with no device and without the virtual-hard-key flag, and the injected-Back rule treated it as a mouse right-click whenever any mouse-capable input device existed, including built-in ones.

tests.title: fix(ci): fall back to the kernel.org Ubuntu mirror when Canonical's are unreachable
tests.summary: Since about 14:58 UTC every Build APK run, including main at 2848484a9 (attempt 2 as well), fails in "Python and native regression tests": tools/ci/install-ubuntu-packages.sh times out on both azure.archive.ubuntu.com and the archive.ubuntu.com fallback, and the job exits 124. From outside Azure the archive answers normally, so GitHub's runners cannot reach Canonical's mirrors.

tests.title: feat(stores): editable launch options for EA store games
tests.summary: Games installed from the EA Store had no way to take launch arguments. The Launch tab only offered launch options for Steam and plain added games, the listing dropped any saved value for store games, and the generated EA launcher ignored arguments passed by the Steam shortcut. Some titles need an executable flag to start or run correctly.

tests.title: fix(gamescope): retry a failed nested swapchain rebuild and log why it failed
tests.summary: On a Pixel 10 Pro (PowerVR D-Series DXT-48-1536 MC1, system driver through libhybris, 0.7.1), a Steam session ended about 14 s after start, just as Big Picture took focus:

tests.title: fix(components): install the real ARM64 Visual C++ runtime instead of registry entries
tests.summary: Enabling the Visual C++ 2015-2022 ARM64 component only wrote VC\Runtimes\arm64 registry values (WinComponents.builtInArm64Runtime). No runtime binaries were supplied, so an ARM64 program that needs them still hit the missing-runtime dialog (#2412). The package engine also dropped every ARM64 MSI (SKIPPLATFORMS in droiddeck-msi-install), so pointing the component at the real redistributabl

tests.title: fix(steam): offer a Games folder as a Steam library when it is not already one
tests.summary: A Discord report says GameNative's library was not found after an update and adding its folder was refused as already in or under a library (message 1569748644469415988). Reinstalling restored it. The device, build, and exact folder path are unknown, so the reported cause is unconfirmed.

tests.title: feat(stores): show the pre-install size in store game details
tests.summary: EA game details can show no pre-install size on the status line or Install button. CatalogItem.sizeBytes remains 0 until a size lookup runs, and the detail page did not request one.

tests.title: fix(ea): retry rejected EA licence token requests
tests.summary: During the reported Dragon Age: Origins launch, EA returned HTTP 409 AUTHENTICATIONFAILED for the owned dragonagena licence request and for the dragonageru request. The same run also returned NOTENTITLED for other locale requests and accepted legacy content ID 70377 (attached launch log lines 202–207 and 228; store listing line 55). This shows inconsistent authentication outcomes a

tests.title: fix(steam): share the Steam app's prefix with shortcuts of the same install
tests.summary: A game installed through the Steam client had its cloud saves downloaded into compatdata/<appid>, but launching the same install folder as an added game ran it as a shortcut with its own compatdata/<shortcut id> prefix, so the saves were not there. The report's session log shows the ownership probe failed because the Steam pipe was unavailable, so the importer kept the folder as a shortcut.

tests.title: fix(graphics): make Auto-owned Mali fallback state explicit
tests.summary: Auto treated the default Mali bridge state as user-owned state. When a matched non-Adreno pair was already installed, Auto could leave the bridge enabled and the session used it instead of the selected runtime pair. The report is Discord log 1569562430973943871; no matching GitHub issue was found.

tests.title: fix(drivers): Auto gives Xclipse GPUs the old RADV pair only where that build supports them
tests.summary: On a Galaxy A56 (Xclipse 540), Auto picked the older "RADV · Samsung Xclipse" pair. Steam was black and ran at about 1 fps. RADV identified the GPU as "AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV VANGOGH)", then logged radv/amdgpu: The CS has been rejected (-22) and VKERRORDEVICELOST.

tests.title: fix(dual-screen): allow game swap to external second screens
tests.summary: The in-game "Game screen" choice and the docked swap button were only offered when the second screen is built in (DualScreen.builtIn). A clip-on dual-screen add-on reports as an external display, so the game could not be moved to it.

tests.title: fix(session): preserve guest monotonic time after long pauses
tests.summary: The pause clock compensation was limited to plasmashell, although session guests load the same preload. A long background pause therefore exposed the full CLOCKMONOTONIC gap to guest processes. The report log shows SIGCONT at 15:31:57.381, 2065 MB left in zRAM at 15:31:57.447, and the game window closing at 15:32:01.216. The zRAM pass also ran at 15:32:00.528, so memory pressure remains an op

tests.title: fix(audio): restart host after stalled wake recovery
tests.summary: After a long device sleep, the resumed AAudio stream could fail to start. Reopening the stream repeatedly succeeded at the API level, but the callback never ran, leaving the audio host in an endless two-second reopen loop.

tests.title: fix(components): keep Mono away from framework GAC
tests.summary: The .NET 4.8 component leaves Wine's builtin mscoree active, so Wine Mono starts while the installed framework GAC remains searchable. Dust then loads Mono mscorlib and native C:\windows\Microsoft.NET\assembly\GACMSIL\System.dll together, and Transistor fails during .NET initialization. Evidence: tools/linuxfs/overlay/usr/local/bin/droiddeck-wincomponents:64-67, /home/max/.local/share/dr

tests.title: fix(graphics): fall back from unsupported auto display drivers
tests.summary: Auto used the bundled turnip25.1.0 display driver for Adreno 710/720/722 because TurnipDriver.chooseByModel grouped every model from 700 to 799 together. On those chips that driver enumerates no Vulkan physical device. The compositor logged present: no physical devices / DDPRESENTFAULT, so the session drew frames that never reached the screen (Steam stuck on its first frame).

tests.title: feat(input): add native PS5 DualSense & DualSense Edge wireless/wired support
fix: a recreated launcher screen keeps running installs and save work busy
tests.summary: After the launcher screen is recreated (a language change, a settings reset, or a configuration change it doesn't handle), work that is still running stays marked busy. It is no longer possible to start a session or remove the Linux runtime while that work is writing into it.

tests.title: fix: a failing agent environment no longer blocks session start
tests.summary: Sessions now start even if the agent environment state can't be read or written.

tests.title: fix: Steam's first frame no longer waits on the client re-downloading itself; a crawling source is dropped for a faster one
tests.summary: Main already falls back from a client-update host that does not answer. It still starts with whichever one answers the manifest first, and that is rarely the fastest. The install now measures all three by fetching the head of the largest component from each, keeps the fastest, and prints the host and the rate it measured, so the log says which one it used. The x86-64 client's own install does th

tests.title: fix: keep 6+2 Oryon cores, Fold SoC names, and 120 Hz display mode across fold changes
tests.summary: Keep all 8 cores in programcores() on 6+2 Oryon SoCs (SM8750-AC / SM8850-AC), strip Samsung -AC/-AB SoC model suffixes in SocNames (alongside the canoe / Adreno 840 platform entries and a hex gpuchipid guard), and pin preferredDisplayModeId across fold/unfold configuration changes in PerfMode and SessionActivity.

tests.title: fix: duplicate cursors and clicks that miss in a game session
tests.summary: Problem. Input in a game session went wrong in several ways:

tests.title: fix: the virtual pads reach non-Steam programs, where udev is resolved through dlsym
tests.summary: Outside Steam the pads were invisible: Firefox and Chromium load libudev with dlopen and look the symbols up with dlsym, which skips interposition, so the browser found no pad even though the virtual device was there. SDL2 (SDLudev.c) and hidapi's Linux backend take the same route, so any program outside Steam that enumerates udev input devices missed them too.

tests.title: feat(input): make the controls toggle and keyboard buttons movable in the layout editor
tests.summary: The controls toggle and the keyboard button were drawn at fixed offsets from the screen corner, so the layout editor could not show or move them: they were not part of the control list, and their positions came from hardcoded insets.

tests.title: Let a game override the session locale
tests.summary:
Wine takes a game's language and codepage from LANG, and every game runs in
C.UTF-8: the rootfs ships only C.utf8, and the session sets LANG=C.UTF-8 for
the whole guest. A game that reads the locale itself starts with the wrong
language and codepage under that, and will not get past its own startup.

tests.title: itch.io: install Linux builds and start them through Steam
tests.summary: Follow-up to #1503. Linux builds in the itch.io version picker, which were listed as "Not supported yet", can now be installed and started through Steam like every other game.

tests.title: Experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for the Linux runtime
tests.summary: This adds an experimental Qualcomm proprietary driver backend for DroidDeck's Linux runtime. Steam, Proton and Linux apps can run on the phone's own Adreno Vulkan driver (or an imported AdrenoTools driver) instead of Turnip. Proton games, the Steam client and Zink-based OpenGL all present through it. The phone's system graphics stack is not modified and nothing needs root.

tests.title: Add opt-in Pixel WoW64 and D3D9 compatibility tools
tests.summary: American Nightmare (Steam 202750) on the tested Pixel PowerVR/WoW64 setup first stopped because device-backed GPU allocations mapped above 4 GiB could not be represented by Wine's 32-bit bridge. After that was addressed, the 3D scene showed bright dotted triangle edges over textured geometry. This submits the reviewed, opt-in low32 and D3D9 single-sample workarounds directly to official DroidDeck,

tests.title: Retain compositor resources when GPU completion is unconfirmed
tests.summary: Finite fence waits can fail while submitted GPU work is still pending. Continuing or tearing down after that result can reset resources still in use or free image memory before completion. This adds a terminal completion-unknown state that stops further presentation and retains pending resources until the app process exits, while preserving the existing genuine-device-loss path.

tests.title: Accessibility tab: install and enable Orca in every Linux session
tests.summary: Adds an Accessibility tab to the launcher's front-end rail: an introduction to Orca (the GNOME screen reader), an install button, an open-settings button and a master switch that defaults on after install.

tests.title: Controller: stick dead zone setting and per-controller profiles (test build, not for merge yet)
tests.summary: This is for testing only, please don't merge it yet. I want a release-signed test build to try on a Galaxy S25 Ultra with an MCON controller, and I haven't run any of it on a device. I'll say when it has been tried and it's ready for review, or I'll close it. Plan and discussion: #580.

tests.title: feat: detailed adds startup step times and game logs, and the diagnostics page has a log level
tests.summary:
The diagnostics page now has a log level under "Session logs", shown only while session
logs are on. Standard is what ships today. Detailed adds:

tests.title: feat: target Android API 36
tests.summary: Moves the app from targetSdk 28 to targetSdk 36 (compileSdk 34 → 36).

tests.title: fix(session): prevent overlapping startup and teardown
tests.summary: Users reported Steam appearing offline. Logs showed Session Replaced after successful sign-in, while downloads still worked. This PR prevents overlapping local sessions, one possible cause, but does not establish the cause of those reports.

tests.title: Rumble: reliable controller motors, Deck haptics, optional Razer Kishi USB rumble; Kishi L4/R4 as Deck back grips
tests.summary: ﻿Fixes the rumble part of #219 / follow-up to #242. Reported in the DroidDeck Discord #bug-reports forum (Kishi V3 Pro on a Galaxy S26 Ultra), with logs there.
